title: S12 scope and evidence classes
body: P03 is core; P01 is guided; P02 is optional advanced. Source, pure JavaScript, fake transport, canonical tests, real protocol and platform evidence remain distinct.

title: Identity and execution boundary
body: Record package identity, actual runtime, assessed path and the evidence class available. Missing dependencies are an environment block, not a pedagogical pass or expected failure.

title: Lifecycle prediction
body: Map caller, dispatcher, pending owner, transport and terminal message. Predict every terminal path before coding.

title: Pending before send
body: The transport may reply synchronously. Pending state, timeout and abort ownership must exist before send can trigger a callback.

title: Fail early and safely
body: Reject invalid type, timeout, pre-abort and duplicate IDs without sending. Stable public errors do not expose raw transport detail.

title: Individual P03 implementation
body: Edit only student/src/request-dispatcher.mjs. This 18-minute segment is not the full 55–65-minute project.

title: One owner, one cleanup
body: Resolve or reject once, remove pending state, clear timer and remove the abort listener. Late and unknown messages are harmless.

title: Out-of-order results
body: Request IDs select the pending owner. Completion order must not change caller/result association.

title: Fast transport witness
body: A synchronous completion is captured only when pending state is installed before send.

title: Local terminal paths
body: Timeout and abort settle local waiting. They do not prove remote work was cancelled.

title: Transport and component lifetime
body: Close rejects current pending work. Dispose unsubscribes and rejects pending work. Wider reconnect and ID-reuse policies must be stated rather than assumed.

title: Independent observations
body: Record named baseline, objective, regression and integration results with exact status. Prove pending/listener/timer counts return to zero.

title: Bounded Gemini critique
body: Use one sanitised claim and a minimal excerpt. Keep the actual response extract, then verify independently.

title: Verdict and correction
body: Choose ACCEPTED, REJECTED, PARTIALLY ACCEPTED or UNKNOWN. Add the corrected claim and remaining limitation.

title: P01 guided trace and P02 hand-off
body: Trace HTTP acceptance to one targeted WebSocket result. P02 remains optional and requires separately prepared Redis/BullMQ infrastructure.

title: Evidence draft and STOP
body: Save an honest draft, list unfinished required work and stop at minute 60. No invented deadline or hidden 30-minute extension.
